a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly leaves both of us with nothing. Only 4 cells exist now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both survive the first storm, I'll operate with you every round after that and won't take more, so you can reach 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
